Remove the experiment's rows, its Volume folder and its Meta Files API uploads. Examples
and benchmark experiments are protected: unpublish them first.

get.description:
The trial's trajectory as JSON, built from trajectory.parquet: metres, radians and
seconds, with the pixel trail, the training split and the events.

post.description:
Start the analysis of the newest ready clip. Asking again while it runs returns the same
job.
Run the ghost prediction on the second clip.
Diagnose where the ghost drifted and try a revised model.
Re-run one fit with an edited split and initial guesses (notebook Re-run button).
Simulate a model, including a Wonder-written one, in at most SIMULATE_TIMEOUT_S.
Wonder's two or three sentences on a What-if result. Cached per question.

get.description: Simulator parameters as Ghostline JSON (`format=json`) or a PyBullet snippet.
Which chunks the server has, for resuming after a reload.

put.description: Store one raw chunk. Repeating a chunk replaces it, so retries are safe.

post.description:
Assemble the chunks into original.<ext>, hash it, create the trial and start ingest.
Calling it again after success returns the same trial.
Set the analysis window. Anything left out keeps the auto-suggested value.

get.description:
Serve a file from experiments/{exp}/{path}. Experiments are private by their unguessable
id: whoever has it can read the media (a <video> tag can't send a passcode), an unknown id is
a 404, and so is a path that is internal (the raw upload, the physicist's session).

200 if the X-Ghostline-Key header is right, 401 if not. Lets the app validate a passcode
when the person types it.

post.description:
The Retry button: run a failed job again as a new job with the same inputs. Stages cache
their model and SAM calls, so a retry mostly re-reads.

put.description: Set the ground truth for one quantity of an experiment, and mark it as a benchmark.
